title: Print documents
subtitle: Review each document before sending it to your printer.
rawPreview: Raw printer commands. This is a source preview, not a rendered page. Check the commands and target printer before sending.
previewFailed: The preview could not be prepared. Check the document or try previewing again.
unavailablePrinter: The saved printer is unavailable. Choose another printer.
connectionFailed: Could not connect to QZ Tray or load printers. Open QZ Tray, check its permissions, and reconnect.
noPrinters: No printers were found. Install or enable a printer, then reconnect.
printerRequired: Connect to QZ Tray and choose an available printer.
invalidCopies: Choose a whole number of copies between 1 and 999.
previewRequired: Prepare the preview before submitting this document.
accepted: QZ Tray accepted this request. Physical printing is not confirmed.
unknownOutcome: The submission outcome is unknown. Check QZ Tray and the printer before requesting another copy. This request will not retry automatically.
cancelledSubmission: The request may already have reached QZ Tray. Check the printer before submitting another copy.
loadingFailed: The document could not be loaded. Request it again and check your connection.
invalidDocument: The document is empty or has an unsupported format. Request a new document and try again.
missingDocument: The response does not contain the selected document. Request a new document and try again.
